deals.title: Women's Translucent Fleece Lined Thermal Tights for $7 + free shipping w/ Prime
deals.sourceText: Cold-weather basics for anyone who wants the look of sheer tights without bare-leg temperatures, since the fleece lining adds warmth underneath. At $7.49, that's $42.50 off the $49.99 list price. Apply coupon code "2NPM6B8I" and the clip coupon on the product page to save. Deal ends November 30. Buy Now at Amazon Features 220g fleece lining for winter warmth Natural sheer illusion skin-tone design High-waist construction for a flattering silhouette High-stretch elastic material for all-day comfort Available in four sizes from S to XL
